title: Google Ads Transparency Scraper & Bulk Domain Ad Checker
description: Extract competitor ads (text, image, video) from Google Ads Transparency Center, bulk-check whether a list of domains runs Google Ads, or summarize an advertiser's strategy. Enter domains (nike.com), brand names, Advertiser IDs (AR...), or Transparency URLs.

queries.title: Domains, Brand Names, Advertiser IDs, or URLs
queries.description: Enter one or more domains (e.g. nike.com, shopify.com), advertiser names, Advertiser IDs (AR...), or Google Ads Transparency URLs.

mode.title: Operation Mode
mode.description: Choose 'ads' to extract ad creatives, 'check_domains' to bulk-check which domains actively run Google Ads (great for B2B lead generation), or 'summary' for an advertiser strategy overview.
enumTitles: Bulk Check Domains (B2B Lead-Gen Ad Spend Qualifier)
Advertiser Strategy Summary (format mix, landing domains, copy)

maxAdsPerQuery.title: Max Ads per Query (or Sample Size for Summary)
maxAdsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of ads to return for each domain/advertiser in 'ads' mode (1-500), or sample size in 'summary' mode (1-100).

adFormat.title: Ad Format Filter
adFormat.description: Filter extracted creatives by format (applies to 'ads' mode).

region.title: Target Region
region.description: ISO country code (e.g. US, GB, DE, FR, CA, AU, ID, IN, SG, BR) or 'anywhere' for global ads.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration (Optional)
proxyConfiguration.description: Not required for normal volume. Enable only if running large batches and experiencing rate limits.
